fusions.name: Caustic Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark of flame that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Fumes
fusions.desc: Burns a reagent in a ring around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each has a 50% chance to be [Damped], its damage lowered, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Burn It Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. For 6 seconds afterwards, they burn off as flames that strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweated Out
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 12% poison resistance.
